text:
maria: Anyone good to lock down pin order for tomorrow's release window? API/runtime/console/router all have cross-deps. Need final pin + rollback plan. Target window 2026-03-21 02:00-04:00 UTC. @kai @ellen @frank please confirm.

kai: Runtime note: we need runtime v2.1.3 pinned on dedicated and hosted. It contains the KV-cache compatibility fix. If we can't pin, fallback is runtime v2.0.x (adds ~30ms p95).

ellen: Console: the new UI hits /routes with the extended schema — requires API >= v1.8.2. If API is rolled back to older, console will show 500s on route list. Prefer pin api=1.8.2.

frank: Router: I'll keep routing rules stable. If runtime -> v2.1.3, router must add header x-runtime-hash=212 for variant selection. I'll canary the header mapping. Can we add backstop: if error-rate>2% send traffic to fallback cluster?

maria: deploy-bot: plan is canary t+15m then 10% -> 50% -> 100% over ~45m. If rollback triggered, full revert to pinned versions and drain new instances.

deploy-bot: new release created: api=1.8.2 runtime=2.1.3 console=3.4.0 router=1.2.0. Canaries: api(10%), runtime(10%), console(5%), router(10%).

anya: Release notes: I'll draft a short blurb about the KV-cache fix and console schema change. Include rollback steps, contact list, and runbook pointer. ETA 1h.

kai: Also: kv-cache migration needs ~5m warmup on canary VMs. Recommend deploy order: runtime -> api -> console -> router (staggered).

frank: Agreed. Router should be last so it can route to new runtime variants. I'll add emergency pin scripts to ops repo.

ops-bot: Change window reserved: 2026-03-21 02:00-04:00 UTC. Pager oncall: dave. Alert channel: #incidents.

maria: :thumbsup: I'll update the runbook and pin versions in the release doc. Posting final pins here when done.

deploy-bot: Canaries started at 1749342120.

maria: canary metrics: api errors 0.3%, runtime p95 +8ms, console 200 OK on routes. Proceeding to 50% per plan.
